errors.evidence: The y-axis label is "Euro/MWh". Therefore, the interval unit is Euro/MWh, not MWh.
The verb "erwärmt sich" (warms up) is semantically incorrect for describing a change in a financial value like Euro/MWh.
Just before the sharp drop in late October 2024, the value is approximately 1.0 Euro/MWh, not 1.7 Euro/MWh.

errors.text_span: wobei sie im November 2024 bei ungefähr -1.6 Euro/MWh und im Januar 2025 bei ungefähr -2.5 Euro/MWh einen Tiefpunkt erreicht
errors.evidence: This clause contains multiple numerical errors. In November 2024, the value reaches a local minimum around -3.5 Euro/MWh, not -1.6. The overall minimum (Tiefpunkt) in January 2025 is approximately -6.2 Euro/MWh, not -2.5 Euro/MWh.

errors.text_span: Die Linie steigt dann auf -4.5 Euro/MWh im Februar 2025.
errors.evidence: The final value in February 2025 is approximately -2.0 Euro/MWh, not -4.5 Euro/MWh.
The description omits the presence of a horizontal black reference line at the 0 Euro/MWh mark.
